target.title: Add CLAW.md manifest support
target.body:
## Summary

Adds `CLAW.md` as a human-readable Claw manifest format. YAML frontmatter is normalized through the same typed manifest schema as JSON; the Markdown body is documentation only.

- package directories may point `package.json#openclaw.claw` at `CLAW.md`
- standalone and feed-resolved `CLAW.md` sources use the same parser and structured diagnostics
- `claws export` now emits `package.json`, `CLAW.md`, and managed workspace sidecars
- malformed frontmatter, including unresolved YAML aliases, fails as diagnostics rather than throwing

This is an OpenClaw compatibility slice above #102982. It does not define the future harness-agnostic `npx claws` specification; it makes the current OpenClaw package format easier to inspect and author while preserving the existing lifecycle contract.

RFC: https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27
Depends on: #102982

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/feed.test.ts src/claws/export.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts` (66 passed)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/claws/reader.ts src/claws/feed.ts src/claws/export.ts src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/feed.test.ts src/claws/export.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `codex review --uncommitted` (no actionable correctness regression)
- `pnpm tsgo:core` remains blocked by the inherited unused import in `src/claws/package-update.ts` (`PersistedClawPackageRef`, TS6133), present in the base commit.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
A human-authored or exported `CLAW.md` package must inspect and add through the normal consented Claw lifecycle, including feed resolution.

Real environment tested:
WSL Ubuntu 24.04, this branch, local OpenClaw CLI with `OPENCLAW_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1` and bundled plugins disabled.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Created a temporary package containing `package.json` with `openclaw.claw: "CLAW.md"` and a typed YAML-frontmatter manifest.
2. Ran `node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws inspect <package> --json`.
3. Ran `node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws add <package> --yes --json`.
4. Ran the full exported-package inspect/add lifecycle E2E and feed-resolution tests.

Evidence after fix:
`inspect` returned `valid: true`, package identity `@example/briefing@1.0.0`, and manifest path ending in `CLAW.md`. `add --yes` returned `status: "complete"` with final agent id `briefing`. The focused suite passed 66 tests.

Observed result after fix:
The same typed manifest works when read directly, through a package directory, through a local feed, and after `claws export`; it retains existing plan, consent, provenance, and lifecycle behavior.

What was not tested:
No external registry/ClawHub fetch or non-OpenClaw harness adapter; this PR is local OpenClaw format compatibility only.
